context.p: There is no precise order in which to create a matrix. However, following these steps in order will provide better results.

step.cmd: Decide how you are going to lay out the matrix, including formulas and empty rows and columns.
Create your sections and add your empty rows and columns as you go.
If any cells are static, add the cell values at anytime.
Extend or copy your sections to fill out the matrix using the Extend function.
Add actions, action flows, and ribbon menus.
